title: Google Maps (internal web API)
description: Google Maps via the web app's own internal endpoints: place search, place details (ratings, hours, phone, website), driving directions, and — with a logged-in Google session — your saved lists and the places in them. No Google Cloud project, API key, or billing account required; search/details/directions also work logged out. NOTE: Maps responds with positional arrays, so these projections are the registry's loudest canary for API rot — when Google reshapes the payload the tools throw instead of answering wrong.
changelog: Adds maps_lists and maps_list_places (signed-in only) alongside maps_search, maps_place_details, maps_directions. Requires engine support for `stripPrefix` (Google's anti-XSSI `)]}'` response marker).

tools.name: maps_search
tools.description: Search Google Maps for places matching a query: name, rating, review count, category, address, coordinates, and the feature_id / place_id that maps_place_details needs. Works logged out.

query.description: Search text, e.g. 'coffee san francisco' or 'ramen east village'

tools.name: maps_place_details
tools.description: Get full details for one Google Maps place: rating, review count, categories, address, coordinates, phone, website, and this week's opening hours. Use a feature_id from maps_search.

featureId.description: Hex feature ID pair from maps_search, e.g. 0x89c259fea13836e1:0xdc1041da3f77c1fd

tools.name: maps_directions
tools.description: Get driving directions between two places: the resolved endpoints plus route options with summary road, distance, and duration. Driving only; origins and destinations are free-text place names or addresses.

origin.description: Start point: place name or address, e.g. 'Empire State Building'

destination.description: End point: place name or address, e.g. 'Grand Central Terminal'

tools.name: maps_lists
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved Google Maps lists — Favorites, Want to go, Travel plans, and custom lists — with name, list id, type (1=custom, 2=Favorites, 3=Want to go, 5=Travel plans, 6=Saved places), and place count. Requires a logged-in Google session; fails logged out. Use a list id with maps_list_places.

tools.name: maps_list_places
tools.description: List the places in one of the signed-in user's Google Maps lists: name, coordinates, and when each was added. Requires a logged-in session; get list ids from maps_lists. To open a listed place, search its name with maps_search and call maps_place_details with the hex feature_id from there — the decimal feature_id pair here is NOT accepted by maps_place_details.
